Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Diwan Saifullah Khan,Faheem Ahmad Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioner even in the revised call.

This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the F.I.R.
dated 13.08.2021 registered with Case Crime No. 169 of 2021 under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.- Jaitpura, District- Varanasi.

(B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent no. 2 not arrest the petitioner in F.I.R. dated 13.08.2021 registered with Case Crime No. 169 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section Mohd. Hasib vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83906936/
1 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.- Jaitpura, District- Varanasi."
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
